description: Get one order's full details by its id: items, the full money column (subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total - all minor units), the frozen discount code, PO number, shipping address, payment/fulfillment status and the parcels (shipments: id, carrier, tracking number and link, status, history) - a parcel's id is what update_shipment takes - the returns (id, number, status, lines with reason and received/restocked units, return-parcel tracking, refunded amount, history) - a return's id is what the *_return tools take - and customFields, the order's custom field values by key.
name: get_order
title: Get order
